audit.whatIsWrong: Five of seven chart rows disagreed with the packet chart and with the whys text: L2 and L3 were given to Illaoi where the text calls them even, Levels 4-5 were 'Skill' where the text says they tip to Wukong, and 2+ items was Illaoi where the text says it settles back to even.
audit.why: The matchup is a dead 50.00% over 1652 games — the largest sample in this slice — so a chart that hands Illaoi four stages misreads it.
audit.corrected: L1-L3 skill, Levels 4-5 Wukong, Level 6 skill, first item Illaoi, 2+ items skill.

audit.whatIsWrong: The level-6 spike was built on the claim that Cyclone interrupts Illaoi's ultimate channel.
audit.why: Leap of Faith is not a channel. Riot's text is 'Illaoi smashes her idol into the ground, dealing physical damage to nearby enemies', and her kit carries no channel flag. A knock-up cannot interrupt an ability with no channel to interrupt.
audit.corrected: Rewrote the level-6 spike around what is verifiable from Illaoi's own kit: Leap of Faith is 450 range and 120s at rank 1, so it is a commit made from on top of him, and it needs the tether landed on the real body first.

audit.whatIsWrong: The decoy interaction was described without the cost of getting it wrong, and Crushing Blow's auto-attack reset was never flagged.
audit.why: Test of Spirit is 900 range on a 16/15/14/13/12s cooldown — a blind tether into a Warrior Trickster decoy leaves you with no E for the whole of that window, which is the actual reason the lane is even. _missing also carries autoreset-burst-tell for Crushing Blow: his damage lands on the reset auto, so the wind-up is the cue, not the cast.

audit.whatIsWrong: _missing carries enemy-dash-deniable: Leap of Faith shutting off Warrior Trickster and Nimbus Strike.
audit.why: That rule derives from a 'grounding' flag on Illaoi's R that Riot's own description does not support. Same call made on volibear.
suspectNames flagged 'Test of Spirit' — the correct Riot name. False positive.

edits.before: At 6 it re-evens: Cyclone interrupts your R but a landed E still lands.
edits.after: At 6 it re-evens: Leap of Faith is 450 range, so you commit on top of him.

edits.before: Even and skill-dependent: your Test of Spirit (E) is the whole game, but Wukong's Warrior Trickster (W) drops a decoy and stealths him, which can break line of sight and dodge your tether if you mistime it. Land E on his real body after he shows his hand, then W (Harsh Lesson) in; whiff it and his Nimbus Strike (E) plus Crushing Blow (Q) armor-shred wins the trade.
edits.after: Even and skill-dependent: Test of Spirit (E) is the whole game and it reaches 900, but Warrior Trickster (W) leaves a decoy and stealths him, so a blind tether hits nothing and strands you with no E for 13-14 seconds. Wait for the real body. His combo also opens with a Crushing Blow (Q) auto-attack reset — the wind-up is your cue to step back, not the cast.

edits.before: Roughly even at 6 — his Cyclone (R) knock-up can interrupt your Leap of Faith (R) channel and peel your tentacle burst, but if you E-tether first your ult still lands. Bait his W-clone before committing so you can confirm the real target for E.
edits.after: Roughly even at 6. Leap of Faith (R) is only 450 range and 120s at rank 1, so it is a commit you make from on top of him, never a disengage. Land Test of Spirit from 900 on the real body first, then Harsh Lesson onto the spirit and spend the ult inside your own field.

edits.before: Level 4-5 tips slightly to Wukong as his Crushing Blow (Q) armor-shred and Nimbus Strike (E) burst spike, punishing any whiffed E. It re-evens at 6: his Cyclone (R) can interrupt your Leap of Faith, but a landed tether lets your ult land anyway — bait the W-clone first.
edits.after: Level 4-5 tips to Wukong: Crushing Blow (Q) shreds armour and Nimbus Strike (E) closes the gap, and a whiffed Test of Spirit leaves you naked for 13-14 seconds. It re-evens at 6, but Leap of Faith is 450 range — the tether has to be on the real body before you spend it.

notes: The brief's enemyKit was null for Wukong, so no cooldowns, ranges or ability text were available for him. I made no new claims about his kit and worked only from Illaoi's verified numbers plus the packet chart. Removed a mechanical error the page repeated three times: that Cyclone interrupts Leap of Faith's 'channel'. Illaoi's R is not a channel — Riot's text is an instant smash and her kit carries no channel flag. If the user wants Wukong-side detail added, this matchup needs a re-run with a populated enemyKit.
